CSY1561R DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS DECLARATION made this 28 day of November, 2006 by and between Vera N. Rutsch, having an office at 437 Warren Street, Brooklyn, N.Y. ("Owner") and Warren Holdings, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 472 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217, referred to herein as ("Developer"). Owner and Developer are sometimes herein referred to collectively as "Declarants". WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land with the building and improvements thereon, in the City of New York in the Borough of Brooklyn, known and numbered as 437 Warren Street, Brooklyn, New York, being more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and herein referred to collectively as the"Owner's Land"). WHEREAS, Developer owns the adjoining parcels of land in the City of New York, in the Borough of Brooklyn with the buildings and improvements thereon, known and numbered as 431- 435 Warren Street, Brooklyn, New York as more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto (hereinafter referred to as the "Developer's Land"). Developer desires to combine Developer's Land into a single zoning lot with Owner's Land pursuant to the "Resolution" as hereinafter defined (Developer's Land and the Owner's Land being sometimes hereinafter referred to collectively as the "Property"); and WHEREAS, Owner has transferred to Developer and Developer has purchased from Owner the right to use One Thousand, one hundred (1,100) square feet of the unused excess floor area and development rights ("Development Rights") now existing and as may hereafter be or become attributable to Owner's Land under the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as heretofore amended August 18, 1977 and as same may have been and Declaration or have waived their right to do so. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises, and other valuable consideration, Declarants, with intent to bind all persons in whom the Property is or shall hereafter be vested, do hereby declare the following: 1. The Property consists of interests in several lots of record, each of which is contiguous for more than ten (1o) linear feet with the adjacent lot on its common boundary. Said lots are located within a single block and are hereby declared to be a tract of land to be treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of the Resolution. 2.
